title: •Obi-Wan’s Cape
caption: •Obi-Wan’s Cape (V)
game_text: Deploy on Obi-Wan. Obi-Wan is defense value +1 and may not be excluded from battle. During opponent’s turn, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a just drawn duel, lightsaber combat, or weapon destiny draw here.
lore: A symbol of the noble Jedi and his mysterious powers.
